AUTOMATON-ENCODE.title: Encode
AUTOMATON-ENCODE.description:
Place this card into your [gold]Sequence[/gold].
When it holds [blue]3[/blue] cards, their effects above this keyword are merged into a Function that costs [blue]1[/blue].
AUTOMATON-STASH.title: Stash
AUTOMATON-STASH.description: Place a card inside of your [gold]Stash Pile[/gold], up to a maximum of [blue]5[/blue]. You draw the oldest card from it at the start of each turn.
AUTOMATON-COMPILE.title: Compile
AUTOMATON-COMPILE.description: An effect that triggers when this card is merged into a Function.
